development.provenance: Hand-authored policy questions with evidence pages manually checked against the PDF.
development.usage_warning: This set was inspected while developing the retrieval pipeline. Report it as a development benchmark, not a held-out test.

test.provenance: New hand-authored questions with section names and evidence pages manually checked against the PDF after the pipeline configuration was frozen.
test.freeze_policy: Run once for final reporting; do not tune retrieval settings against these results.

metric_scope: Evidence-page retrieval only. Evidence-page Hit Rate@K and MRR@K are not complete-evidence recall, answer accuracy, or production quality metrics.
